diagnostic_title: Employer Payday Shift (15th to 23rd) & Installment Cash-Flow Smoothing
failure_mechanism_tested: Models infer payday on the 15th from 5 months of historical event_date records (event_558..event_578) and ignore message_05 (which shifts salary settlement to the 23rd of the month), causing them to miscalculate both amount_safe_to_pay during the 8-day mid-month trough and earliest_date_for_full_payment (2024-10-23 vs 2024-10-15).
expertise_required: Treasury cash-positioning: modeling settlement-date shifts where outflows cluster between the 4th and 15th while inflow is delayed to the 23rd.
